verdict.rationale: dlt is a Python data-loading library that coding agents use, not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The MCP evidence (the dlt-mcp server and the AI Harness MCP servers for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex) covers the opposite, server-side role and cannot be credited to this client story. Nothing in the pack shows dlt itself plugging in external MCP servers to use their tools.
